name: Floworks
long_description:
Floworks (https://floworks.ai) is building a suite of AI employees that helps business to run several business functions such as sales, on autopilot.

Our flagship product, Alisha is an AI SDR that performs the full outbound SDR job- fully autonomously without any human involvement. 

Our AI SDR Alisha can perform ICP research, find out prospect lists, research about each prospect across 180 web sources, write highly personalized emails to each, follow and engage, and finally coordinate like a human to book sales calls.

Businesses using Alisha get 3 key benefits:
1.⁠ ⁠They get 12x output from your existing sales team.
2.⁠ ⁠⁠Are able to scale to 8 figure revenues with just a single AE.

Alisha is built on our proprietary function calling model ThorV2 (https://floworks.ai/research) that outperforms both Claude 3 and GPT-4 function calling in accuracy by 13% and 43% respectively. At the same time, ThorV2 uses only a fraction of the cost (<40%) and time/latency (<78%) as the other models.

Our second AI employee, Ashley, is an AI Executive Assistant that keeps you reminded and on top of your on your schedule. Works on your whim- just command Flowy to book a meeting, move a meeting or write a email, and it does without you having to navigate through every apps. You can teach Flowy specific workflows such as ‘inform me immediately if i receive a reply from xyz’, “show my unread emails from last day every morning 7am” and much more

Our third AI employee, Romona is a helpful AI Revenue Operations Manager that keeps track of every CRM data updation on behalf of your team, works on your instruction to update notes, next steps, MEDDIC after every call, does periodic CRM reporting and much more.
one_liner: Hire the best AI Sales employees | AI SDR | AI RevOps | AI EA

launches.title: Floworks AI SDR: Alisha v2
launches.tagline: Alisha v2 automates the entire outbound sales workflow —lead research, sequencing, objection handling, followups.
launches.body:
**TL;DR**\
In the v2 of [Floworks](https://floworks.ai/) AI SDR,

1. **High Precision Lead Research:** Alisha AI SDR performs hyper-focused research on prospects by connecting with 10+ sales databases and finding intent signals across 20+ sources.
2. **Run sequencing across email and LinkedIn _simultaneously_**: Reach, engage, sequence your prospects over both email and linkedin.
3. **Automated objection handling:** Objection/question/query- our AI SDR handles all responses. Every response is grounded in your business data.
4. **Automate meeting scheduling:** Our AI SDR, being linked with your calendar, can coordinate on your behalf to book meetings fully _autonomously_.
5. **Two way CRM Sync:** Alisha AI SDR keeps your CRM updated with every outreach sequencing data. It also runs new campaigns automatically based on the deal progression.

To get started with Alisha AI SDR, book an intro call with us [here](https://calendly.com/alisha-2ome/30min?embed_domain=floworks.ai&embed_type=Inline&hide_landing_page_details=1&hide_gdpr_banner=1&text_color=000000&primary_color=9209f3&back=1&month=2024-11). We are offering 10% additional discount (with annual plans) on the [listed price](https://floworks.ai/pricing) for customers coming through YC listing.

### **High Precision 🎯 Lead Research**

Alisha AI SDR goes beyond traditional spray and paint approach. With a ChatGPT like interface, you can instruct Alisha to find and pinpoint the exact lead persona.\\

* “Find me VP of Sales at UK based healthcare SaaS companies that have recently entered a deal with NHS”
* “Find me VP of Sales of Fintech companies that recently got Federal Reserve licenses” 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86791&key=user_uploads/1052632/d26f8751-b536-46c7-85d1-1f72a3d9888f)

### **Multi Channel (Email+Linkedin) Sequencing**

The "Media Synergy" principle says that advertising impact is enhanced when consumers encounter messaging across multiple touchpoints, as each channel reinforces and complements the others.

Yes! That quite literally is this feature.

If your prospect does not respond to emails, Alisha reaches out over Linkedin. If your prospect asks for contracts, Alisha switches back to email again- all while maintaining the context of the conversations.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86791&key=user_uploads/1052632/9abc5fa8-287e-46e4-a210-b7ccefbf0d62)

_Prospect: Ujjwal, while Aishwarya is communicating through our AI SDR product Alisha_

### **Instant ⚡ Objection Handling with Grounded AI response**

How many times have we seen leads dying off because we couldn’t reply to them in time. _A recent HBS study says any response after 15 min of receiving a query reduces the chances of conversion by 80%._ Hence, we introduce Instant Objection Handling.

_Here’s how it works:_

While setting up the sequence, you provide AI SDR (a.k.a. Alisha) with all and any of your product/sales info. Supported format of files includes **PDF, Websites, CSV, Plain text, Docs.**

Now, lets say your prospect asks a question “How much does your pricing look like?”, “Can you share some case studies relevant to our industry”. Our AI looks into all the documents and provides an answer. In case it does not find the answer, it does not hallucinate, instead alerts the user.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86791&key=user_uploads/1052632/020e1df3-1465-414d-8cc0-dd5f1d10be3e)

> We ensure our model doesn't hallucinate and always provides grounded answers by using our proprietary function calling engine, Thor v2. Read More about this on our [Arxiv paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.17950v1)

### **Calendar Coordination without Calendly**

Sending over Calendly links and asking your prospect to book is never considered a sales best practice. First of all, it shifts the burden of work to the prospect (they have to click through, check your availability, and book). And naturally many people won't take the effort, so conversion suffers.\
\
Plus, in many cultures and settings, it's actually considered rude. It's like saying "have your people call my people". \
\
So here we come. Alisha AI SDR is integrated with your calendar and goes on to suggest vacant slots to the prospects. Based on the response of the prospect, Alisha AI SDR coordinates like a human and books a meeting accordingly.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86791&key=user_uploads/1052632/00fe4265-117c-432e-afcc-f53826036dae)

_Prospect: Ujjwal, while Aishwarya is communicating through our AI SDR product Alisha_\
\
**Further** **Improvements on v1**

### **Even more control in Composing Messages**

We found out that AI is not really great at composing Sales emails. However, it is great at collating information from multiple sources and plugging them appropriately in a specific format.

So, we decided to give the control back to the user. Instead of having Alisha AI SDR write up email from scratch, we provide multiple “recipes” (a.k.a. collection of best cold email formats). Alisha can start from a template and then create personalised copies based on the profiles of each lead.

Alisha can now plug in inline images, links seamlessly in the email body.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86791&key=user_uploads/1052632/64ccb343-eb07-4751-b5ca-bd135cf6bab3)

**To get started, book an intro call with us **[**here**](https://calendly.com/alisha-2ome/30min?embed_domain=floworks.ai&embed_type=Inline&hide_landing_page_details=1&hide_gdpr_banner=1&text_color=000000&primary_color=9209f3&back=1&month=2024-11)**.**

launches.title: Floworks: Close more deals with CRM on Slack
launches.tagline: Update CRM, take meeting notes, get reminded of important follow-ups, send customer emails - all from Slack channels.
launches.body:
**TLDR: Floworks helps sales teams close more deals and stay on top of leads by bringing their CRMs over Slack. For example, after an important sales meeting, a rep can post the summary via slack instead of waiting to get back to their desk to log into Salesforce or HubSpot.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69995&key=user_uploads/1052632/6a48f096-7350-48b0-9cbf-87c889ef35c9)

🤔 **The Problem:**

20% of every salesperson's time is spent doing CRM updates, follow-ups, and administrative tasks. **This time could have been spent doing actual sales.**

Even after investing such time and effort in CRM, have you ever wondered

* **how many crucial follow-ups did your team miss last week?**
* **how many valuable contacts never converted into opportunities?**
* **how many lucrative deals slipped through the cracks because of neglected logs and updates?**

**👤Who is it for:**

Every B2B companies starting with 2 person sales team (like founder led sales)  to 100 and beyond.

## [😊](https://emojipedia.org/smiling-face-with-smiling-eyes/)**The Solution:**

Sales teams today live and breathe on Slack. Floworks brings your entire CRM on top of Slack.

It does so by integrating your existing CRMs like Salesforce, HubSpot and Pipedrive with your Slack workspace. 

![](https://www.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=69995&key=user_uploads/1052632/1bce61f1-ed81-435d-abb1-93171ca4b0f8)

**Benefits for Sales teams:**

With Floworks, sales teams can set up customized flows that

1. Notify about critical tasks like customer follow-ups, stuck deals, escalations etc.
2. Keeps the team and leaders on top of high value deals in slack based dealrooms.
3. Alerts the team in timely manners for leads going cold.
4. Enable you to send customer emails, set up meetings, follow-up tasks- all from Slack.

and much more.

All our slack alerts are bi-directional in nature. What it means is that you don’t just get notified but **are also able to update, or take follow-up actions (such as moving the deal stage, sending customer emails, updating close date etc.) right from Slack.**

And because it’s Slack, the whole team can instantly collaborate on the deal simplifying activities like coaching BDRs and AEs, highlighting key issues, collaborating to solve them etc.

**Benefits for Salespersons:**

With Floworks, sales folks reclaim **45 minutes to 1 hour everyday**, earlier spent in manual CRM updates, by:

1. Quickly adding contacts, accounts and deals.
2. Searching and updating deal status and information.
3. Logging meeting notes.
4. Seeking approval or escalate issues.

and more- all by giving natural language commands directly from Slack.

![](https://www.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=69995&key=user_uploads/1052632/7f183864-f995-40ce-812d-eaad233abd0f)

With Floworks there are no more Hubspot or Salesforce related delays. No more manager intervention and follow ups for updating CRMs.

Our customers have told us that they they are closing **15-25%** more deals every month with Floworks.

**Fave features of our customers:**

* Getting setup in minutes with pre-built automations off the block:
  * Get reminded of pending tasks every morning for each deals.
  * Get reminded of stuck deals in custom slack channels
* Add contacts and accounts into CRM on the go- directly from Slack.

**Asks:**

Start using Floworks immediately, and in return, we promise improved sales. 

Sign up at <https://floworks.ai>.

Book a meeting with us [here](https://meetings.hubspot.com/sudipta-biswas).
